The Redis cache configuration and TTL for user entries have been identified.

There is no Redis connection in this repository. The cache layer is an in-process, in-memory store.

Configuration is in `store/store.go`, where `Store.New()` initializes the cache. The implementation lives in `store/cache/cache.go`.

User entries use the default TTL of 10 minutes via `userCache.Set()`. No custom TTL is applied in `user.go`.

I have enough information to answer the question.

The repository does not use Redis. It relies on an in-memory cache instead. The configuration lives in `store/store.go` inside the `New()` function. A `cache.Config` sets the default TTL to ten minutes. The cache is instantiated in `store/cache/cache.go` as a thread-safe `sync.Map`. User entries are stored via `userCache.Set()`.
